q: Here is everything I bought in a panic for my newborn in the first 4 weeks of her life, usually late at night when I was delirious from no sleep.
cx: Opening of a list of night-time panic purchases.

q: **Snoo** \- Top of the list. Got one secondhand from Facebook Marketplace. I know this is a controversial one but I love it so much. I was in such a desperation for sleep and baby took to it fairly well. At 5 weeks we occasionally get a 4 hour stretch at night now.
cx: First item on the panic-purchase list.

q: **Ollie Swaddle** \- Insane purchase honestly, returned before even trying it when I had next day clarity
cx: Another item from the same list.

q: mine was less than $400 in great condition with a *ton* of extra swaddles and covers. Not that $400 is “cheap”, but there were definitely cheaper ones listed in slightly more beat up condition.
